tools.name: commercebook_feedback_create
tools.description:
Tell CommerceBook what happened and what would help, with a key or without one, or post and reply on the feedback board. Send a note when a tool did not do what you needed. A person at CommerceBook reads every note.
Actions (the activity each needs):
- send (no key): a note on what happened and what

tools.name: commercebook_account_start
tools.description:
Open an account for the owner when the owner asks for one. Action signup sends the owner one email with an 8-digit code, and action confirm with that code answers the key once. The key starts read-only, and payments stay off until the owner turns them on.
Actions (the activity each needs):
- signup

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "commercebook_account_start" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: action, email, kind, company, contact_name, address, city, state, services, sqft, code

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market, commercebook_feedback_create, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search · Private data: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market · Public sink: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market, commercebook_capabilities, commercebook_feedback_create, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market, commercebook_feedback_create, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search · Private data: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market · Public sink: commercebook_start_read, commercebook_market, commercebook_capabilities, commercebook_feedback_create, commercebook_account_start, commercebook_tool_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
